Structure files were assigned to engines at import (engine label source: --engine), and every file was recorded by its SHA-256 checksum. Analyses were run with RNPLens 0.4.0.dev0 (qualified component set 0.2.0.dev1 (internal identifier: RNPBench toolkit 0.2.0.dev1)). Report recorded its software environment as Python 3.11.15, NumPy 1.26.4, Biopython 1.84.

MEASURES
Residue-nucleotide contacts were taken from the per-structure contact lists written by RNPLens Report; a contact was defined as a protein residue and RNA nucleotide with any heavy-atom pair within 5.0 A, in construct positions (Report's own contact lists). For each contact and each RNA or protein position, the number of structures listing it was counted per engine (denominators: 10 eligible structures of BOLTZ2). Report's pairwise agreement measures were not computed for BOLTZ2, because Report computes them only for exactly two eligible structures of an engine (BOLTZ2: 10 structures). Report's agreement measures were also computed for BOLTZ2, between the engine-designated structures of runs run_A and run_B. RNPLens Diagnose was not run; it is blocked in this version (DIAGNOSE_BLOCKED). Contacts in RNA 1-4 were listed per run from the same per-structure contact lists, in construct numbering, for 10 structures from 2 runs.

AGREEMENT BETWEEN RUNS
Agreement between runs within the region was described by listing contacts shared by all compared runs, contacts found only in one run and contacts present in some runs, with counts of runs and structures; no agreement score was computed.

MISSING OUTPUTS AND UNRESOLVED POSITIONS
A contact not listed by a structure was recorded as absent only where both residues were resolved in that structure's file and otherwise as not observed (coverage of the region: 10 complete, 0 partial, 0 unresolved structures). All included structures were eligible for Report's contact analysis. Measures that could not be computed were reported as not computed and were not set to zero.

REFERENCE-BASED AND REFERENCE-FREE MEASURES
No experimental reference structure was supplied, so no reference-based measure (RNPLens Evaluate) was computed. The contact counts and agreement measures are reference-free and descriptive (a count or agreement across the supplied predictions).
